text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Narita Brian—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A plushie, huh...? It brings back memories 
of the past.

Following her gaze, I see a crane game 
filled with plushies inspired by 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I had a plushie just like that when I was 
little. ...It was a matching set with Sis, 
wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Don't need it. Not 
interested right now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Not to a plushie, and certainly not to a 
game like this.
choice_data_list:
Crane games are surprisingly deep, you 
know.

Crane games are surprisingly deep, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...How is that anything special? It was 
just playing around.
choice_data_list:
It takes sharp instincts to read the 
distance.

You need sharp instincts to read the 
distance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh. Then show me. Show me the true 
essence of the crane game."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I went out of my way to come watch you. 
Don't you dare show me some half-assed 
performance, got it?"
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
